info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Collateral Administration By Param1-spec
info.description: The Collateral Administration Update API allows users to modify existing collateral administration records within the party asset directory. This API is primarily designed for financial institutions and asset managers looking to maintain accurate collateral data. By utilizing this endpoint, users can ensure that their collateral management processes are up-to-date and compliant. Typical consumers include risk management teams and operations staff responsible for collateral tracking and reporting.

put.summary: Update an asset entry for a specific party.
put.description: This operation allows for updating the asset information associated with a particular party in the asset directory. It is crucial for maintaining accurate records of party assets and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the information related to a specific party's asset directory in the collateral administration system. It contains detailed attributes that are essential for the update operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
